title: Polymeropoulos feels betrayed by the CIA

tellings.quote:
Mark Poly Moropoulos,
who was on the 60 Minutes piece, said it
very well. It's like he loves the CIA,
but
>> they've betrayed him.

plain: A former CIA officer named Marc Polymeropoulos still loves the agency but feels it has betrayed him. That is how Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the National Security Agency (the US spy agency for intercepted communications), sums up what Polymeropoulos said on a segment of 60 Minutes, the American TV news programme, about Havana syndrome, the mysterious illnesses reported by US officials. Haseltine passes it on as something Polymeropoulos 'said very well', a sign of how some officers feel about how the CIA handled their case.
